ahead: hunts/prime_pair_error/RANK3_ARC_TRANSFER.md finds that the O(N^3) transfer cost RANK3_ROUTE_D.md section 6 identifies is an artifact of an avoidable step, not a real obstruction: the arc-restricted quantity U_(q) is always <= the full-circle quantity T_N(q,a) summed over a, by plain monotonicity of integrating a nonnegative integrand over a subset of the circle (proof is two lines; checked numerically against direct evaluation of F_N, K_N at N=120 for six (q,a) pairs, and the underlying (D7) Parseval identity was independently cross-checked at four (N,q) pairs -- both all pass, see results_rank3_arc_transfer_probe.json). Combining this with RANK3_ROUTE_D.md's own equation (D10) (which does not depend on the transfer step) gives U_(q) <= 2 mu(q)^2 sum_b T(q,b) + O(mu(q)^2 rho_2(q)^2 N / phi(q)) with NO transfer term at all -- i.e. RANK3_ROUTE_D.md's boxed (D11) minus its third term, and a strictly better bound. Summed over 2<=q<=R_0 the surviving explicit (rho_2) term is O(N L^6), negligible against any N^{2+epsilon} target. So dyadic large sieve does not need adapting to this transfer quantity, and in fact does not fit it: (24)-(27) bounds a sum over many well-spaced centers a/q at one shared beta (an LS input), while the transfer quantity T_N(q,a) - arc integral is a single center's integral over beta outside its own arc -- there is no second index to space out, so there is no well-defined entry point for LS on this object, independent of whether it needs bounding at all (it doesn't). This is distinct from RANK3_SCOPE.md's already-known 'Route B' failure (applying (24)-(27) directly to U_(q) for small q, which costs O(N^3 L^3) at the single block q=2 -- still open, not addressed here). The only genuinely surviving requirement for rank 3's U-side, after this fix, is exactly RANK3_SCOPE.md's Route A: a uniform estimate for Delta(t;q,b)=psi(t;q,b)-t/phi(q) at moduli q growing like a power of N, summed as sum_{q=2}^{R_0} mu(q)^2 sum_b T(q,b) needing to be O(N^{2+epsilon}). That estimate is not attempted here (out of scope for this task) and remains, as far as any source document shows, without an unconditional closing route (the only route named anywhere, at q=1, assumes RH and is circular against this hunt's own unconditional target). Z_(q) is untouched: RANK3_ROUTE_D.md section 7 already gives a separate, structural reason (no |P_{q,a}|^2 decay factor in Z's integrand) why even a working transfer idea would not help there, and this document does not revisit that.

work.what: Attempt RANK3_SCOPE.md's Route A: an unconditional, uniform-in-q estimate for Delta(t;q,b) = psi(t;q,b) - t/phi(q), for reduced b mod q and moduli q growing like a positive power of N (specifically 2 <= q <= R_0 = Q/L where Q = floor(sqrt(N)/3), L = log N), strong enough to make sum_{q=2}^{R_0} mu(q)^2 sum_{b mod q reduced} T(q,b) = O_epsilon(N^{2+epsilon}) for every epsilon>0, where T(q,b) = sum_{t=1}^N Delta(t;q,b)^2 + sum_{t=1}^{N-1} [Delta(N;q,b)-Delta(t;q,b)]^2 (hunts/prime_pair_error/RANK3_ROUTE_D.md equation D5). This is the sole remaining requirement to close rank 3's U-side (the mixed moment U_(q) for 2<=q<=R_0 in UPPER_BOUND.md's equation 23), after hunts/prime_pair_error/RANK3_ARC_TRANSFER.md removed the previously-claimed additional O(N^3) transfer-step obstruction; RANK3_SCOPE.md section 3's own assessment is that this estimate's only known unconditional-adjacent closing route (at q=1, via classical Delta(t)=O(sqrt(t) log^2(2t))) assumes RH, which would be circular since the hunt's target (N^{2+epsilon}) itself implies RH via CHHL's lower bound (UPPER_BOUND.md section 1). Do not assume RH; an unconditional route, an averaged-in-q variant that still plugs into the arc-by-arc structure (UPPER_BOUND.md's 18 and 23 need control at each q, not just on average), or a precise negative/cost result (what exponent in q or N is actually reachable unconditionally, and why) are all valid outcomes.
